fieldNotes.qualifications: Diploma/Bachelor/Master groups from the merged 'Degree' header. 'university'/'college' follow the sheet's University 1/2 and College 1/2/3 columns.
fieldNotes.proceededFiles: Project-type counts. 'outside' is column Y (headed 'Ourside' in the sheet); 'own' is split into 'academic' and 'workbased'.
fieldNotes.outcomePossibility: Risk tier: No Risk / Slight Risk / High Risk.
